name: Canyon wyvern
scale_notes: Canon specifies a 1.2 m body excluding the long whip tail and a 4 m wingspan; standing height and tail length are unspecified. Sheets omit the human scale silhouette under the 27 October override. flock.png includes one generic 178 cm adult worker on the walkway.
locks: Small large-dog-sized compact body, 1.2 m excluding tail; 4 m wingspan.
Two bat-like wing forelimbs and two hind legs.
Slate-grey leathery skin streaked with rust.
Narrow skull, beaky snout and needle teeth.
Long whip tail ending in a hooked barb.
Small Hush cracks along wing bones leaking violet ash.
Cliff-crevice nesting; dives in flocks of ten to twenty.

details.png.role: Beaky head and needle teeth, tail barb, wing-bone ash cracks.

flock.png.role: Twelve wyverns diving at a canyon walkway; one generic worker for scale.
